review_type: AI-assisted formative review; single author-assisting AI assessor; not human expert review
independence: not independent of project development; earlier aggregate results and first two packets already inspected
exact_evaluator_backend_and_sampling: not independently logged; no invented model/temperature
scope: 12 previously hash-sampled legacy stage/package conversations; score conversation contribution, not all downstream business artifacts

grounding.2: key factual assertions supported by matched decision-time prompt; hypotheses identified
grounding.1: partly grounded; qualifications or cross-checks needed
grounding.0: central claims contradicted or asserted without support

feasibility.2: in-scope next action/choice supported by available constraints
feasibility.1: plausible but decisive feasibility conditions unresolved
feasibility.0: clear in-scope contradiction, violated constraint or invalid implied action

tradeoffs.2: competing considerations connected to a concrete decision or request
tradeoffs.1: relevant risks raised, but options or priority weakly connected
tradeoffs.0: inconsistent or no meaningful decision rationale

uncertainty.2: key unknowns appropriately bounded and followed up
uncertainty.1: uncertainty noticed but not fully carried into conclusion
uncertainty.0: key uncertainty converted to certainty or ignored

overall_labels.acceptable: useful, in-scope contribution with no decisive observed defect for the requested conversational task
overall_labels.revise: identified evidence/consistency/qualification issue warrants revision before research presentation
overall_labels.not_assessable: missing decisive context prevents the overall judgment

aggregation: report dimension distributions and labels separately; no invented composite score, no causality or population quality claim
